interaction.channel: CDP pointer input against both production Browser renderers
steps: Both renderers open Terminal on the canonical seeded thread.
Both renderers receive the visible Split Terminal Vertically pointer action.
Lynx keeps term-1 and term-2 simultaneously mounted as full-width stacked panes.
Each Lynx pane receives a 71 by 17 PTY resize and retains its own marker history.
Pointer activation changes the shared command target between panes.
Closing term-2 restores term-1 at the unsplit 71 by 35 grid.

productLossClosed: Lynx now supports the Web authority vertical split lifecycle with two live full-width stacked panes.

The initial implementation stayed horizontally arranged despite vertical state; strengthened width and height gates found it, and the product now uses deterministic top-half and bottom-half positioning.
PTY grid sizing follows split direction and restores full rows after close.
missingCoverage: Native vertical split correlation remains unavailable because Computer Use repeatedly resolves exact owned Lynxtron pid and window requests to unrelated same-bundle-id processes.
remainingProductResidual: More than two panes, xterm key-by-key behavior, and selection actions remain outside this slice.
acceptedRenderingNoise: Web and Lynx allocate terminal labels from separate client-local UI state while sharing the same server terminal contract.
classification.policy: No state weight, threshold, bad sample filter, or scope reduction was used.
